blurb: Grand Master C. S. Kim brought Tang Soo Do to the Pittsburgh area in 1974, creating the first C. Kim Karate school. We seek to enhance your confidence, focus, self-control, and provide a fun way to exercise. Our instructors are made up of a group of talented and creative professionals, who are passionate about providing the best Karate Schools in the Pittsburgh area.
